text: Refines D-0072 for #544: a watcher keeps its lease through GitHub failing. A failed lease read, or a push error other than ErrLeaseMoved, keeps only the last confirmed lease. The watcher reports the error, retries renewal on each poll once it's due, never pushing without a successful read, and goes on acting until a minute before the confirmed expiry, by its own clock. The failure never extends the lease or grants one before the watcher has acquired it, and a ref-moved refusal or another holder's unexpired lease stops effects at once. A lease lasts fifteen minutes by default instead of five, so an outage shorter than about seven minutes can't drop a running step. Crash takeover can then wait about sixteen minutes from the last renewal, plus polling; drain and shutdown still release the lease at once. On 2026-11-04, GitHub's 500s during renewal stopped the holder and let its standby take over, dropping #538's build.
